purpose: Define per-resource reauthentication requirements with minimum assurance, allowed authentication methods, bounded validity and optional key rotation.

topics.name: Resource Reauthentication
topics.purpose: Define per-resource reauthentication requirements with minimum assurance, allowed authentication methods, bounded validity and optional key rotation.

semantics.resource_rule: Resource/operation may declare required assurance independently from its authorization rule.
semantics.methods_rule: Allowed reauthentication methods are explicit per resource/policy.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Successful reauth produces a resource/session assurance elevation with explicit lifetime.
semantics.rotation_rule: Successful reauth may rotate applicable keys/credentials when the owning policy declares it.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed/expired reauth leaves the protected operation denied.
semantics.scope_rule: Reauth elevation applies only to its declared session/resource scope and cannot silently elevate unrelated resources.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

prose.summary: Define per-resource reauthentication requirements with minimum assurance, allowed authentication methods, bounded validity and optional key rotation.
